rubric.score_contract: All seven full criteria (100 points) require actual independent rubric review. Native technical checks cover 80 points as upper bounds. For each criterion, final_score=min(native technical points upper bound + that criterion professional maximum, actual independent rubric score). Professional maxima total20 and are never prefilled or separately added. A normalized objective result is not a final reward or semantic status assessment.
rubric.layout_policy: The visible model-data-dictionary.md/json is the financial handoff contract. Required workbook-scope names identify arbitrary single cells; no label vocabulary, neighbor direction/distance, sheet name or coordinate is prescribed. All sensitivity combinations use public point names and can appear in any readable matrix/long-table/vertical layout. Missing or malformed required names are normal invalid submissions scored0; financial errors retain actual criterion scoring; trusted-source/code/Office/judge faults are verifier failures with no reward.
not_automated: visual usability beyond native rendering and page count
meaning of actual active/invalid distribution-status text; no private phrase enumeration
rubric.status_semantics: Evaluate actual decision cells in every recalculated case in objective.events, together with D, proposed, lower/upper bounds or invalid-input context. Any clear correct wording is acceptable. A phrase elsewhere, a negated correct word, or a wrong decision with correct numeric results does not satisfy the state requirement. Both endpoints belong to the permitted interval; an accurate equality description is acceptable. For D<=0 the status must communicate no positive distribution space, even when proposed=0. Missing, nonnumeric or out-of-range active input must communicate unavailability and its reason. Missing unselected inputs must not block a valid active case.

business_handoff_contract.sensitivity_layout: 30个业务名称各指向15组合的D或上限余量结果。可以矩阵、长表、纵向分块等任意布局；行列坐标、标题文字和轴与数值距离不限。d00/d05/d10/d15/d20表示收入下降百分数；r0/r500/r1000表示新增预留万元。两类结果必须为真实公式并引用对应业务输入。
business_handoff_contract.validation: 必需名称缺失、坏引用或重复名称将无法完成模型交接。金额、公式与分配状态需保持业务口径一致；文件或计算环境异常应在交接说明中说明。
